issues.description: Endpoint path naming for the same conceptual resource (persons) is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement describes and the client implementation uses the path segment "/persons" (e.g. POST /persons, GET /persons), while the server-side reference implementation exposes the endpoints under "/people" (e.g. @GetMapping("people")). This mismatch ("persons" vs "people") breaks the direct mapping from requirements -> client -> server and will cause students' requests to not reach the server or appear to fail, creating unnecessary confusion when wiring up and testing the API.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a single consistent endpoint path for the Person resource across problem statement, client and server. Prefer aligning the server to the documented and client-used path "/persons" (change @GetMapping("people") / @PostMapping("people") / @PutMapping("people/{personId}") / @DeleteMapping("people/{personId}") to use "persons"), or alternatively change the client and the problem text to use "/people" — but do not mix both. Updating the server mappings to "persons" will preserve the problem statement and client expectations with minimal student confusion.
